Raw intake minus metered retail is not a leakage estimate. Treatment reject/process use and other accounting components require water-loss audit reconciliation.
Reported full-time residential population excludes any unreported seasonal/tourist interpretation; commercial accounts are not a direct visitor count.
CSV report layout omits some visual summary fields; PDF is authoritative for the connection/use table.
2024 uses 366 days and 2025 uses 365 days for computed daily averages.
records.retrieval_note: Use the canonical public report viewer and a fresh anonymous session for PDF/CSV exports; a direct GET may return only the HTML wrapper. Do not reuse historical session URLs.
